sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Advertising Business - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Recently, an interesting guy reached out to me, name Ragman. I'm sure you've heard of him. We worked out a little deal… he needs his product advertised. Sounds like something anyone could handle, but that's bullshit. Who's going to buy armor off some guy who got iced in the first gunfight? That's right, no one. That's why I need you, with your survivability. The task is boringly simple: use the Hexgrid."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Win 3 matches while wearing the Hexgrid armor in CheckPoint mode

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +12,000 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.01
- 93,300 Roubles
- 15 GP coins
- Unlocks BlackRock chest rig (Gray) in the Armory

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Requirement | Notes |
